content.short: AirSwap Subgraph indexes on-chain AirSwap data to extract actionable insights via GraphQL.
content.description: AirSwap Subgraph is an indexing tool that uses GraphQL to access and organize on-chain data from AirSwap smart contracts. Built on a graph-based indexing protocol, it surfaces essential metrics such as daily swap volumes, per-transaction details, and user balances. These insights help developers create customized analytics or trading tools for the AirSwap DEX, supporting activity monitoring, liquidity assessment, and informed integration decisions.
